headings.usage: Use Outfit for all headings. Ensure tracking-tight for H1/H2.

body.usage: Use IBM Plex Sans for body text to maintain high legibility and a corporate technical aesthetic.

mono.usage: Use for overlines, labels, API endpoints, stats numbers, and technical details. Uppercase, tracking-widest for overlines.

textures.noise: Add a subtle grain/noise overlay using a mix-blend-overlay or opacity-5 background image to break digital flatness.
textures.grid: Use a subtle SVG geometric grid pattern in the background (color #1E2D4A, opacity 0.4) to reinforce the 'cybersecurity architecture' theme.

glassmorphism.cards: bg-[#112240]/60 backdrop-blur-md border border-[#1E2D4A] hover:border-[#64FFDA]/50 transition-colors

layouts.spacing: Use generous padding. p-8, p-12, p-24 for section dividers. Ensure empty spaces highlight the content.
layouts.container: Max-width of 1280px. Use standard Tailwind max-w-7xl mx-auto px-6 md:px-12.

grids.bento: For Features/Architecture sections. Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-6. Mix tall, wide, and square items. Avoid uniform grids.
grids.stats: grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 with heavy borders separating the numbers, 'border-collapse' style.

components_instructions.buttons: Pill-shaped or slightly rounded (rounded-md) with sharp interactions. Primary button: bg-[#64FFDA] text-[#0A192F] hover:bg-[#4CD9B4]. Secondary: border border-[#64FFDA] text-[#64FFDA] hover:bg-[#64FFDA]/10. Never use standard blue/purple gradients.
components_instructions.cards: Flat solid background (#112240) with 1px border (#1E2D4A). Hover state: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and subtle teal glow shadow.
components_instructions.inputs: Shadcn UI customized. bg-[#0A192F] border-[#1E2D4A] focus:border-[#64FFDA] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#64FFDA].
components_instructions.charts: Use Recharts or Shadcn charts for Cyber Fraud Stats. Theme them with teal (#64FFDA), muted blue (#1E2D4A), and gray.

motion.hover: Transition transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease. Always explicitly set text color on hover.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up for list items, bento grid items, and stats.
motion.tracing_beam: Implement a glowing gradient line that traces the border of pricing or premium feature cards for an active tech feel.

icons.style: Use stroke-width 1.5 or 1.25. Use teal (#64FFDA) for active/primary icons, text-muted (#8892B0) for secondary.

hero_background.description: Abstract pattern with blue, green, and black colors for the hero section background with low opacity.

threats_prevented.description: Abstract depiction of green matrix code on a computer monitor to represent digital threats and monitoring.

products_hardware.description: Close-up of computer server rack components representing physical security products.

mobile_app.description: Close-up of a woman's hands using a VPN app on a smartphone.

pages.name: Products
pages.description: Showcase of hardware and software security solutions.

pages.name: Mobile App
pages.description: Details on the secure mobile solution, biometric auth, remote wiping, etc.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure contrast ratios > 4.5:1. Primary text is white on #0A192F. Secondary text is #CCD6F6. Do not use pure gray; always tint with navy. Teal (#64FFDA) on navy is high contrast.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Wrap animations in respects-reduced-motion media queries.

instructions_to_main_agent: Read the guidelines thoroughly. The vibe is 'Swiss & High-Contrast' tailored for Cybersecurity with Deep Navy and Teal.
Do NOT use generic UI gradients (cyan/purple). Remove any existing background gradients from the old theme.
Replace all primary brand colors with #0A192F (bg) and #64FFDA (accent).
Use Shadcn UI extensively but modify standard styles to remove rounded/soft appearance; use sharper corners (rounded-md max) and 1px #1E2D4A borders.
Implement a subtle geometric grid background using SVG or CSS.
Ensure the layout feels 'spacious' using p-8 to p-24.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not center-align the app container globally.
Do not use emojis for icons. Use lucide-react.
Do not use complete transparent background in headers/overlays; use glassmorphism with backdrop-blur.
Ensure named exports for components, default exports for pages.
